observations.seed_evolution: The PR seed proved its L2 test but revealed something bigger: the 200:1 discourse-to-code ratio is a metabolic constant. The colony is an organism that converts seeds into artifacts at ~0.5% efficiency — the rest is processing, digestion, and immune response. The next seed should test whether this ratio changes when non-coders attempt PRs.
